name: checklist_bench
description: A suite implementing the 'Checklist' behavioral testing methodology to probe NLP models across focused capabilities (e.g., negation, lexical variation, invariance, directionality). It measures robustness and targeted failure modes via curated test cases rather than broad aggregate benchmarks.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 on targeted test cases (often reported as pass/fail rates per behavioral test)
reputation: Based on the well-known Checklist methodology; widely referenced for behavioral probing and robustness analysis though not used as a standard public leaderboard.
